one_liner: LASSO feature selection across 369 physiological, behavioral, and dietary measures to see which predict academic, physical, and military performance.
problem: West Point assesses cadets on three pillars: academic, physical, and military. With hundreds of measurements from wearables, surveys, blood work, and diet records, which of them actually carry information about each pillar, and do the pillars share predictors?
approach: I joined device-based sleep and activity data with demographic, fitness, psychosocial, dietary and biomarker measures for a Fall 2024 cohort, with data collection supported by USARIEM. I used 10-fold cross-validated LASSO to select predictors for each outcome, then ran the inference on held-out data so that selection and testing never touch the same rows. The public repository runs end to end on a synthetic dataset with a planted signal, so anyone can check the pipeline without study records.
decision_relevance: Where to invest in cadet support: if academic and physical performance respond to measurable, changeable factors while military performance does not, resources for the military pillar belong in mentorship and experience rather than monitoring.

headline_results.claim: LASSO feature selection across 369 physiological, behavioral and dietary measures on 238 cadets, over academic, physical and military outcomes
Inference runs on held-out data through sample splitting, cross-validated R2 and a permutation null, so selection and testing never happen on the same rows
On synthetic data with a planted signal the pipeline recovers exactly the planted predictors and returns a null model for a pure-noise outcome

limitations: Single institution and a single semester.
Study records are restricted human-subjects data and are not public; the repository ships synthetic data only.
blockers_before_featuring: Post-selection inference: OLS p-values, CIs, and R² are computed on the same data LASSO used to select features. On a pure-noise synthetic outcome this procedure produced R² = 0.23 with every coefficient p < 0.02. Replace with sample splitting or selective inference plus cross-validated R² against a permutation null.
Military model falls back to lambda.min when lambda.1se is null; the fallback is what selects noise.
README Physical table lists 1 feature but claims 4; manuscript.tex is referenced but absent.
Owner step: run tools/extract_schema.R and R/make_synthetic.R locally, then push the safe restructure (local commit 86efe89).
caveat: The public repository ships code and synthetic data. The study data is human-subjects research and stays private.
